text:
Lior Beres I feel you are a bit angry and chose to take it out on me personally or using me as an example to prove your point and moans about the system rather than trying to see the best way to help people

I agree that on the face of it there should not be any reason why her parents should not be allowed in automatically - we agree on this along with everyone probably on this group

No need to take it out on me 😂😂

But you show ignorance of subtle differences

The B2 Visitors ( tourist) permit is one thing

The person and their activity here is another thing

And their intention in coming here is another thing

They all need to line up - it is not always straight forward

The border control needs to be satisfied that its all genuine    - there are many cases that it not and you don’t mention those!!!

And i certainly am not hinting to conceal identity

But every time i go to Paris doesn’t mean i need to visit my daughter in Nice and I do not need to volunteer that I have a daughter in Nice but if asked I would tell them the truth - nothing illegal in that by anyones standard
